name: koozee
description: Create fashion images and videos with AI—all in one place.

interface.shortDescription: Create fashion images and videos with AI—all in one place.
interface.longDescription: Koozee is an AI visual marketing tool for fashion retailers, brands, and entrepreneurs. Use it with Codex to create virtual try-ons, on-model lifestyle images, and fashion marketing videos with simple prompts. Let Codex run workflows to generate images and videos in batches, or build your own on Koozee’s visual canvas. From product listings to marketing campaigns, create compelling visuals and make your products stand out.
defaultPrompt: Use Koozee’s Virtual Try-On Skill to automatically try these 10 outfits on their corresponding models.
Use Koozee’s AI Background Skill to batch-generate eye-catching on-model lifestyle images for these outfits.
Use the 9-Grid Storyboard Skill to turn this model photo into a short fashion video for social media.
